description:
Compare a contractor's quoted price with BidBud's likely range for the same scope.

    Prices the scope at economy, mid-range and premium quality and judges the
    quote against the likely range (confidence band) of the quality level being
    compared. Verdicts: "low" (below the range: ask what is excluded), "fair",
    "high" (above the range but within premium pricing) and "very_high" (above
    even the premium range). Use it when a homeowner asks "is this bid reasonable?".

    Args:
        quoted_price: The contractor's total price in USD for the listed services.
        home_sqft: Finished square footage of the home.
        num_rooms: Number of rooms.
        services: The services the quote covers.
        quality_tier: Quality level the quote is for: "economy", "medium"
            (mid-range, default) or "high" (premium).
        zip_code: US ZIP code of the property, for regional labor pricing.
        state: Two-letter state code, used when the ZIP is unknown.
        stories: Above-grade stories (1, 1.5, 2 or 3; default 1).
        flooring_type: For flooring quotes: carpet, tile, vinyl, hardwood or mix.
        num_windows: For window quotes: number of windows being replaced.
        roof_pitch: Roof slope if known: low, standard, steep or very_steep.
        roof_shape: gable, hip or complex.
        home_type: detached, townhouse_end, townhouse_middle or condo.
        year_built: Year the home was built (before 1978 adds lead-safe work practices).
name: check_quote
title: Check whether a contractor quote is fair
